examples.title: Example 1: Dialog Box with an Image Above Text
examples.description: This example implements a dialog box with an image above the text content, through the use of imageRes, content, and other properties.

examples.title: Example 2: List-only Dialog Box
examples.description: This example presents a dialog box consisting solely of a list defined with selectedIndex and radioContent.

examples.title: Example 3: Dialog Box with Text and Check Boxes
examples.description: This example illustrates a dialog box that combines text content with check boxes defined with content and checkTips.

examples.title: Example 4: Text-only Dialog Box
examples.description: This example demonstrates a simple text-only dialog box defined with primaryTitle, secondaryTitle, and content.

examples.title: Example 5: Loading Dialog Box
examples.description: This example implements a loading dialog box that contains a progress indicator.

examples.title: Example 6: Dialog Box with a Custom Theme
examples.description: This example presents a dialog box with a custom theme, through the use of content, theme, and other properties.

examples.title: Example 7: Dialog Box in Custom Color Mode
examples.description: This example presents a dialog box in the specified light or dark mode, through the use of content, themeColorMode, and other properties.

examples.title: Example 8: Dialog Box with Custom Content
examples.description: This example implements a dialog box with custom content defined with contentBuilder and buttons.

examples.title: Example 9: Popover Dialog Box
examples.description: This example demonstrates a popover dialog box for alert purposes, through the use of visible, popover, targetBuilder, and other properties. This functionality is supported since API version 14.

examples.title: Example 10: Setting the Default Focus Button for a Dialog Box
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the button that receives focus by default in a dialog box using AlertDialog, including the defaultFocus property. This functionality is supported since API version 18.
